card.name: First digit of phone number groups
card.fires_on: A single digit that begins a phone number group right after a country code, area code, or 1-, such as the 8 in 1-800. Seen in contact lines for poison control, companies and press offices.

modes.label: US toll-free numbers
modes.description: The 8 right after 1- in a toll-free number given for information or poison help.
modes.example: contact the National Poison Control Center at 1-<<8>>00-222-1

modes.label: International or area-code numbers
modes.description: The first digit after a country code or area code in a contact number.

card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a phone number's main part, as in a contact line.
